description:
Calculate the maximum flood depth at a specific location for the five most upstream cross-sections in the Muncie model.

For each of the 5 most upstream cross-sections (highest River Station numbers):
1. Identify the Left Bank Station coordinate.
2. Determine the target location: exactly 50 feet into the left overbank (Target Station = Left Bank Station - 50).
3. Determine the ground elevation at this target station using linear interpolation of the cross-section geometry.
4. Extract the maximum Water Surface Elevation (WSE) for the unsteady flow simulation.
5. Calculate flood depth = Max WSE - Ground Elevation (report 0.0 if dry/negative).

Save the results to a CSV file at `/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/overbank_depth_assessment.csv` with the following headers: `River_Station`, `Left_Bank_Station_ft`, `Target_Station_ft`, `Ground_Elev_ft`, `Max_WSE_ft`, `Flood_Depth_ft`.

Also save a summary text file to `/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/assessment_summary.txt`.
